failure.detail: The command uv pip install --python /opt/scbench/.venv/bin/python -r requirements.txt timed out after 30 seconds because the local wheelhouse lacked the declared pyarrow==16.1.0 and pytest==8.1.1 distributions.

repair.method: Add the exact Linux CPython 3.12 pyarrow 16.1.0 wheel and the exact pytest 8.1.1 wheel, then activate the existing read-only local wheelhouse for file_merger.

rerun_rule: Rerun only file_merger from checkpoint 1 through 4 under the original frozen candidate-screen settings. Do not reuse artifacts from the invalid setup attempt.
